title: Online FlowChart & Diagrams Editor - Mermaid Live Editor
summary: An online editor that uses Mermaid syntax to generate flowcharts and diagrams from text input, serving as a lightweight alternative to complex diagramming tools
why: Useful for quickly creating documentation and visual aids by generating diagrams directly from simple text scripts.

fingerprint.title: Online FlowChart & Diagrams Editor - Mermaid Live Editor
fingerprint.description: Simplify documentation and avoid heavy tools. Open source Visio Alternative. Commonly used for explaining your code! Mermaid is a simple markdown-like script language for generating charts from text via javascript.
